who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), port-memo-1113 lane K1 (blaze-keyed read-addressed)
what: A body's asks of a fact its own unit makes were answered from a made table that did not hold the maker's row yet: empty until the first body settled (L's rows were added only by refresh_made in settle/quiesce), and in a cold or audited unit nothing until the maker settled, which no wait covered (the wait needed L). The audit then redid a hit found at the 'absent' address with the maker settled and faulted on the read (audit_never_faults_without_a_plant, the audit control), and an incremental edit ran a reader twice (a_signature_edit_redoes_exactly_its_readers: 4 bodies for 3).
cost: an extra run and an extra record filed per reader of a kept maker's fact; an audit fault with no bug in any record
cause: the made table had two owners (L's rows and settled makers) and was only made whole at settle and quiesce, while the wait for makers looked at L alone
class: a provisional table read before it is initialised, by a check that consults a different table than the asks it guards
prevention: the made table is refreshed once L is read, and the one wait (waits_on_maker) reads the same table the asks are answered from, over the shape actually about to be asked
fix: this lane: refresh_made in got_last; probe parks a slot whose shape has a made fact with an unsettled maker (or no row while another examined item is unsettled), resumed at its probe
